about: The commit and the training-source digest of the single-commit rerun of the capacity seeds that the appendix of the paper describes. The hash of the commit is replaced by a label, as in equivalence.json and in the test fixtures. The label and the digest are the new_sha and the new_training_sources_digest of the waivers in equivalence.json that name this commit, and the private record of the rerun names the same commit and the same digest.
